svg.aria-label: A recording-style demo of deploying cloudmail. Clicking Deploy to Cloudflare creates the Worker, R2 bucket, KV namespace, Vectorize index, Durable Objects and Workers AI binding in your account. Then the app's own screens: create the owner account with the setup token, and Guided setup, which connects Cloudflare with one token, activates the licence, picks a domain, shows the plan to review, applies it and reports each change, and waits for the first message to arrive in a new mailbox.
